visual.name: zentrixNetworkGraph
visual.description: A network & relationship graph with a deterministic, pinnable layout that stays put. Force, tree/org-chart and cluster layouts, Louvain community detection, guided exploration, and in-sandbox insights — all offline in the Power BI sandbox.

dataRoles.description: Required. The 'from' end of each relationship — a category column of node identifiers. One row = one edge.
dataRoles.name: source

dataRoles.description: Required. The 'to' end of each relationship. Self-loops (source = target) and parallel edges are supported.
dataRoles.name: target

dataRoles.description: Optional. A numeric measure per edge; drives edge thickness. Defaults to 1 when unbound.
dataRoles.name: weight

dataRoles.description: Optional. A category for the source node of each row; drives node colour (and, later, clustering). Target-only nodes use a neutral colour.
dataRoles.name: nodeCategory

dataRoles.description: Optional. A numeric measure for the source node; drives Node value. When unbound, Node value uses the total connected Edge weight (or degree for unweighted data).
dataRoles.name: nodeSize

dataRoles.description: Optional. A parent-node key. When bound, unlocks org-chart / tree layout (Enterprise).
dataRoles.name: nodeParent

dataRoles.description: Optional. Source node's latitude. With Longitude, unlocks Geo-route layout (nodes placed on their geography — flights, rail, supply chain). No map tiles are fetched.
dataRoles.name: latitude

dataRoles.description: Optional. Source node's longitude. Pair with Latitude to enable Geo-route layout.
dataRoles.name: longitude

dataRoles.description: Optional. A category per relationship (e.g. flight / rail / ferry). Drives edge colour + line style, with a legend — the 'typed edges' link-analysis pattern.
dataRoles.name: edgeType

dataRoles.description: Optional. A date or numeric value per edge for the temporal play axis (edges appear over time).
dataRoles.name: time

dataRoles.description: Optional. A per-node image as a base64 data: URI (e.g. data:image/png;base64,...). Renders in place of the node marker. Only data: URIs render (external URLs are ignored to keep the visual certified); base64-encode images in Power Query.
dataRoles.name: nodeImage

dataRoles.description: Optional. A semantic entity name per node (e.g. Person, Company, Server, Database) shown as a monochrome vector in place of the node shape and pattern. Legacy unicode glyphs remain supported. Cert-safe (no external assets); a bound image takes priority.
dataRoles.name: nodeIcon

dataRoles.description: Optional. Business fields shown in node hover cards and click-through details. These can replace or supplement network metrics.
dataRoles.name: tooltips

nodeImages.description: Appearance of nodes that have a bound Node image (base64 data: URI).
